claims.text: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of Class A common stock.
claims.excerpt: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.

claims.text: The proposed offering consisted of 825,000,000 Class A shares, 801,351,354 offered by Anthropic and 23,648,646 by existing stockholders.
claims.excerpt: The proposed offering consists of 825,000,000 shares of Class A common stock. Of these, 801,351,354 shares are being offered by Anthropic and 23,648,646 shares are being offered by certain existing stockholders.

claims.text: The initial public offering price was expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share.
claims.excerpt: The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share.

claims.text: Anthropic expected to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 123,750,000 additional Class A shares.
claims.excerpt: Anthropic also expects to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 123,750,000 shares of its Class A common stock.
